admission.justification: A future UI change must not bypass writer admission or authoritative gate visibility through a private review-only disposition path.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer writer-authority boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: The reviewer submission/read surface names the existing authoring authority and its provenance; a stale comparison disables submission rather than selecting substitute inputs.
exclusions: No new serving authoring endpoint, no assertion that this rendering module executes the writer/gate, and no automatic memory acceptance.
statement: Disposition authoring belongs to the existing writer and gate rather than a private reviewer write path.
